ModMetaData.description:
Ledger v2 — colony credit & debt leverage.
Draw Credit from colonist gizmos (spawn silver, open dated debt), then repay or extend. Default on debt burns credit and goodwill. No power tax. No permanent global markup. Reserve mood opt-in only.
